account: The National Hurricane Center's Forecast Verification Report for the 2025 season is dated 30 March 2026. It states that 2025 marked the first time NHC incorporated AI-based models into real-time operations. In the Atlantic track comparison, the Google DeepMind ensemble mean (GDMI) slightly outperformed the official forecast at lead times from 12 to 72 h. Official forecasts outperformed the consensus aids TVCA, HCCA and FSSE. In the eastern North Pacific, GDMI performed considerably better than every other individual model. It beat the official forecast and all consensus aids at 48–120 h. For intensity it was the top individual model from 12 to 48 h. GDMI was not available early in the season, so the first storms are excluded from these comparisons.

ai_role.statement: NHC's own homogeneous verification isolates GDMI's track and intensity performance against official forecasts, consensus aids and other models. The sample excludes early-season storms, when GDMI was unavailable.

fields.account: The National Hurricane Center's Forecast Verification Report for the 2025 season is dated 30 March 2026. It states that 2025 marked the first time NHC incorporated AI-based models into real-time operations. In the Atlantic track comparison, the Google DeepMind ensemble mean (GDMI) slightly outperformed the official forecast at lead times from 12 to 72 h. Official forecasts outperformed the consensus aids TVCA, HCCA and FSSE. In the eastern North Pacific, GDMI performed considerably better than every other individual model. It beat the official forecast and all consensus aids at 48–120 h. For intensity it was the top individual model from 12 to 48 h. GDMI was not available early in the season, so the first storms are excluded from these comparisons.
